common.tagline: Panchayat-level weather intelligence, downscaled from IMD block forecasts
common.comingSoonBody: This screen is part of a later build phase.

login.value1Body: Built on IMD's official block forecast; panchayat values average back to it.
login.value2Body: Rain probabilities and a High / Medium / Low badge for every panchayat.
login.value3Body: Agromet advisories in Telugu, Hindi and English, ready to send.
login.heading: Extension Officer sign in
login.subheading: Sign in to see panchayat forecasts and issue agromet advisories.
login.demoHint: Uses a cached forecast for Gajwel block. Works offline.
login.errNotConfigured: Sign-in is not set up on this server yet. Use Demo Mode.
login.errGeneric: Could not sign in. Check your connection and try again.
login.farmerA: Farmers don't need to log in. Your extension officer sends a link by SMS or WhatsApp that opens your panchayat's forecast and advice in Telugu, Hindi or English.

topbar.demoLocked: Demo session: sign in to use live data
topbar.cachedHint: Live data is unavailable. Showing the last cached forecast.

home.title: Select your area
home.subtitle: Choose a block to see today's panchayat-level forecast.
home.alertsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No alerts} one {# alert} other {# alerts}}
home.pickBlock: Pick a state, district and block to continue.
home.audience: For Agriculture Extension Officers and DAMU staff. Farmers receive advisories by SMS / WhatsApp link.

alerts.none: No threshold alerts for the next 5 days.

blockMap.title: {block} block
blockMap.subtitle: Same forecast, two resolutions: IMD block value vs downscaled panchayat values.
blockMap.clickHint: Tap a panchayat to open its 5-day forecast
blockMap.rainNote: mm/day · IMD rainfall categories · same scale on both maps
blockMap.scaleNote: Same scale on both maps, across all 5 days
blockMap.boundaryNote: Village names and locations: OpenStreetMap. Block and panchayat boundaries are approximate (drawn for this prototype), not official.

panchayat.confBody: Confidence comes from how much the forecast models agree for this panchayat. High: models agree closely. Medium: some spread. Low: large spread; advice falls back to cautious, block-level GKMS guidance.
panchayat.noAlerts: No threshold alerts in the next 5 days

advisory.title: Crop advisory
advisory.subtitle: Pick the crop and growth stage. Advice is generated from this panchayat's 5-day forecast.
advisory.pickStage: Pick a growth stage to generate advice.
advisory.none: No advisories triggered for this crop and stage. Conditions are normal.
advisory.explainLowConf: Confidence is Low for Days 1-3, so cautious block-level advice is added.

advisories.title: Advisories
advisories.subtitle: Pick a panchayat in {block} to generate its crop advisory.
advisories.noBlock: Select a block on Home first.

share.title: Share advisory
share.subtitle: Send the approved advisory to farmers in their language.
share.segments: {n, plural, one {# SMS part} other {# SMS parts}} · {enc}
share.ucs2Note: Telugu/Hindi SMS use Unicode: 70 characters per part (67 when split).
share.simulated: Simulated send: no real SMS or WhatsApp gateway is used in this prototype.
share.scan: Scan to open the farmer page on a phone (same Wi-Fi)
share.noLan: Open this app via your laptop's Wi-Fi address to scan from a phone.
share.indexSubtitle: Recent sends. Approve an advisory to share it with farmers.

farmer.noAdvice: No advisory from your extension officer yet. Check the forecast below.
farmer.noVoice: This phone has no voice for this language; reading in {lang}.
farmer.rainedQ: Did it rain in your village today?
farmer.thanks: Thank you! Your answer helps improve the forecast.
farmer.already: You already answered today. Thank you!
farmer.offline: You are offline. Showing the last saved forecast.
farmer.basedOn: Based on IMD's official block forecast
farmer.error: Could not load the forecast. Please try again.
farmer.getAlerts: Get weather alerts on this phone
farmer.alertsOn: Alerts are on for this phone
farmer.alertsBlocked: Notifications are blocked. Allow them in the browser settings.
farmer.alertsNeedHttps: Alerts need a secure (https) link on phones.
farmer.sosSimulated: Practice alert (demo), not a real forecast

sms.title: Get advice on SMS / WhatsApp
sms.body: Your extension officer's weather advice for this panchayat, sent to your phone. Free.
sms.name: Your name (optional)
sms.consent: I agree to receive weather advisories and alerts for this panchayat by SMS / WhatsApp. My number is used only for this and is shared only with the agriculture department. I can stop anytime.
sms.error: Could not save. Please try again.

alertCenter.title: Extreme-weather alerts
alertCenter.subtitle: IMD colour-coded warnings for {block}. Siren only for Orange/Red with High or Medium confidence.
alertCenter.simulated: SIMULATED demo event, not a real forecast
alertCenter.soundHint: Play a siren once for each new Orange/Red alert.
alertCenter.none: No active warnings for this block.
alertCenter.sent: Push {push} · SMS {sms} · Voice {voice} (SMS and voice simulated)
alertCenter.pushOff: Push not configured on the server
alertCenter.subscribers: {n, plural, =0 {no phones subscribed} one {# phone subscribed} other {# phones subscribed}}

validation.title: Model validation
validation.subtitle: Does downscaling beat copying the block value? Scored at stations never used in training.
validation.placeholder: Illustrative numbers (synthetic seed). Run the validation pipeline for real results.
validation.podHint: Probability of detection: share of observed rain days that were forecast
validation.farHint: False alarm ratio: share of forecast rain days that stayed dry
validation.csiHint: Critical success index: hits / (hits + misses + false alarms)
validation.wetDays: Wet days (≥10 mm observed): {n}. Kshetra closer {better}, worse {worse}, similar {similar}.
validation.stationsHint: Colour: green = Kshetra error lower, red = higher. Click a station.
validation.backtestText: {date}, {station}: observed {obs} mm, block {block} mm, Kshetra {ours} mm
validation.engineHint: Held-out 9 km cells, never used in training. Target: ERA5-Land / ECMWF. Not station data.
validation.noEvents: Fewer than 5 observed events: not scored.

changes.title: Changes since the last forecast
changes.none: No meaningful changes since the last run.

bulk.title: Advisories for all panchayats
bulk.subtitle: Crop and stage come from each panchayat's saved profile. Review, then send in one go.
bulk.empty: Generate drafts to review advice for every panchayat.

farmerReports.title: Farmer rain reports (crowdsourced)
farmerReports.subtitle: "Did it rain today?" answers from the farmer page vs the forecast.

farmers.title: Farmer contacts
farmers.subtitle: Who receives advisories in {block}. Import the lists you already hold (Rythu Bharosa, mKisan, PM-KISAN) or let farmers join from their page.
farmers.columns: Columns: name, mobile, panchayat (name or id), crop, language (te / hi / en).
farmers.errUnknown_panchayat: Row {row}: panchayat "{value}" not in your block
farmers.name: Name
farmers.empty: No farmer contacts yet. Upload a list or share the farmer page link.
farmers.privacy: Numbers are masked for privacy. They are used only to send advisories; farmers can stop anytime.

officers.title: Officer accounts
officers.subtitle: Only admins add officers. There is no public sign-up.
officers.adminOnly: Only an admin can manage officer accounts.
officers.name: Name
officers.domainHint: Official emails only (gov.in, nic.in). The officer sets their own password from the invite link.
officers.linkHint: Send this link to the officer (email / WhatsApp). It works once and expires in {hours} hours.
officers.signupOff: Public sign-up is turned off. Accounts exist only if an admin invites them.
officers.confirmRemove: Remove {name}? Their login stops working immediately.

setPassword.title: Set your password
setPassword.subtitle: Welcome to Kshetra. Choose a password to finish setting up your officer account.
setPassword.invalid: This invite link is invalid or has expired. Ask your admin for a new one.
